lines.zh: 我们一群在河里一起游。
lines.en: We swim as a school through the river.

lines.zh: 我的红腹在浑水里很亮。
lines.en: My red belly glows in the murk.

lines.zh: 我贴着同伴的侧边前进。
lines.en: I travel alongside my fellows.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的节奏和大家一样。
lines.en: My tail beats with the same rhythm as theirs.

lines.zh: 我们绕过沉在水里的树。
lines.en: We round a sunken tree.

lines.zh: 水一有动静，我们就转向。
lines.en: At any stir, we all turn.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇的缝隙里游过。
lines.en: I slip between the reeds.
I lead this group along.
I press toward the shallows.
We swim tight, not scattering.

lines.zh: 水里那点血味，引着我们走。
lines.en: That trace of blood draws us on.
I slide along the undercurrent.

lines.zh: 我们停在水里，一起转向。
lines.en: We stop and turn as one.

lines.zh: 河水一动，我们就围上去。
lines.en: The water stirs and we close in.
My fellows circle beside me.
I listen for sounds on the surface.
Blood in the murk, very faint.

lines.zh: 我咬着水，等第一口血味。
lines.en: I bite the water, waiting for the first taste of blood.
The school hovers by the weeds.
We wait, and we wait together.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候最像一块石。
lines.en: Still, I resemble a stone.
My belly glints underwater.
I adjust my position slowly.
A fellow brushes my flank.
The river is quiet today.
I wait for something to fall in.
You stand in water to your knees.
Red-bellied fish smell blood fastest.
I swim past your leg.
Your hand underwater is very pale.

lines.zh: 我闻到了你身上的味道。
lines.en: I caught your scent.
We gather round; it's not polite.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，几十颗牙都在动。
lines.en: When I open my mouth, dozens of teeth stir.
You back to the bank; we follow.

lines.zh: 水里这么多影子，都是我同伴。
lines.en: All those shadows are my fellows.
You've stepped into my stretch.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，盯着你的脚。
lines.en: I keep still, eyeing your feet.
You can't tell which one is me.
We circled once, still here.

lines.zh: 你心跳一快，我的同伴全来了。
lines.en: Your heart speeds up and my whole school arrives.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西还在滴血。
lines.en: What you hold is still dripping blood.
I look up at you from below.
In this river, we decide.

lines.zh: 你要不要往岸上退一点？
lines.en: Care to step back onto the bank?
I'm struck away, and swim back.

lines.zh: 这一下打散了我们一群。
lines.en: That scattered the school.
There's a gash across my red belly.
A little blood drifts in the water.
The others gather again.
I retreat to the edge of the weeds.
A flash of pain is fine.
We gather in greater numbers.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的味道，血腥混着河水。
lines.en: I remember your taste: blood mixed with river.
This wound won't stop me swimming.
Blood! That's blood!
The whole school stirs.

lines.zh: 血味一散开，我们全冲上去。
lines.en: The scent of blood spreads and we all rush in.

lines.zh: 我们围上去，很快就没了。
lines.en: We swarm it; it won't last.
That's not enough to share.
My teeth start clicking together.
Don't let go, and don't hold too tight.
We circle it three times.

lines.zh: 红腹的我们，专挑血腥味。
lines.en: Red-bellied, we follow the smell of blood.
I get this bite first; don't compete.

lines.zh: 你踩到我们一群中间了。
lines.en: You stepped into the middle of us.
We bump your leg and scatter.
Underwater hits feel like pebbles.
Our scales brush together.
Don't stomp; you'll tread on us.
Your shove rolled me over.
The whole school scatters.
Water splashes up at your face.
We gather back at once.

lines.zh: 我们撞完散开，水面才平。
lines.en: We crash, scatter, and only then does the water calm.
A fellow comes very close.
Our red bellies press together.
The weeds can hide our eggs.
We swim as a group.
It circles me again and again.
The river is lively this season.
We rest side by side under the weeds.
The murk covers us.

lines.zh: 它的牙和我的磕了一下。
lines.en: Its teeth clicked against mine.
The river carries us along.
I snap it up and take it.
I turn over whatever has sunk.
A fellow tries; I bit first.
I bite it into two.
I hold these scraps in my mouth.
Things on the bottom scatter fast.
I grab it and swim off.
It's stuck on my teeth.
The school scraps over it.
The rest I leave to the river.
That moving thing is ours.
The blood smell comes from it.
The whole school has locked on.
It stands in the water, unable to move.

lines.zh: 我的红腹在浑水里最亮。
lines.en: My red belly is brightest in the murk.
We all turn toward it.
Red bellies flash and the water churns.
There's no path for it in this river.
I pick that part.
The others have followed.
Don't let it climb the bank.
Good, move together.
We have it surrounded.
I want its ankle.
This meal will feed everyone.
Everyone, begin.
The school presses in.
Wherever it goes, we go.

lines.zh: 水里黑压压一片，都是我们。
lines.en: The water's black with all of us.
It backs onto stone and loses footing.
Our circle tightens.
When it lifts a foot, we follow.
The murk hides us.
I hear it panting.
It can no longer touch bottom.
One more ring and it can't move.
No hurry; there are many of us.
Its blood spreads in the water.
This distance is right for a lunge.
We've changed direction twice.

lines.zh: 我听见它踩水的声音乱了。
lines.en: The sound of its feet in the water turns frantic.
I'm a hand's width from its foot.
We're ready.
Closer still.
This ankle bite, I will not let go.
The whole school lunges at once.

lines.zh: 我的牙很小，但咬得很紧。
lines.en: My teeth are small but they grip hard.
The water goes red at once.
It kicks wildly in the water.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退开，换同伴上。
lines.en: I bite, fall back, and another takes over.
That softened its leg.
We drag it toward deeper water.
It slaps the water in a mess of noise.

lines.zh: 我换了个位置，再咬一口。
lines.en: I shift position and bite again.
Its trousers are torn open.
We circle around it.
It sinks into the river mud.

lines.zh: 这一顿，我们吃得很干净。
lines.en: We leave very little of this meal.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鞋带，往后拖。
lines.en: I bite its laces and drag backward.
Its knee cracks against a stone.

lines.zh: 我们从水草下一起出来。
lines.en: We come out from under the weeds together.
A red tinge ripples the surface.
The piranha school has arrived.

lines.zh: 水里忽然多了很多影子。
lines.en: Many shadows have appeared in the water.
We came down from upstream.
This school numbers a dozen or more.
A row of teeth shows in the murk.
We smell blood.

lines.zh: 河面安静下来，那才可怕。
lines.en: The surface goes quiet; that's the frightening part.
We swim along the bank.
We slip out from under the roots.

lines.zh: 水面上只看到一串波纹。
lines.en: Only a trail of ripples shows above.
We swim on, following the blood.
We know this bend best.

lines.zh: 沙底被我们搅起一片浑。
lines.en: We stir the sand bed cloudy.
We've come up from downstream.
This school has no leader.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃得我们兴奋。
lines.en: The light on the surface excites us.

lines.zh: 水面上的火一燎，我们全散了。
lines.en: Fire on the surface scatters us all.

lines.zh: 我们被抛起来，摔回河里。
lines.en: We're thrown up and crash back into the river.
My mouth is open but water won't pass.

lines.zh: 爆炸把整群鱼都震散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters the whole school.
The arrow passed by my gills.

lines.zh: 那股力在水里追着我们。
lines.en: That force chases us through the water.
Too hungry, we dare not move.

lines.zh: 雷一进水，我们全都翻白。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and we all roll up.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我们掉了下去。
lines.en: No water here; we fall away.
